mapper.select: select p.post_id, p.publisher_id, p.post_type, p.lifecycle_status, p.review_status, p.title, p.description, p.item_category_id, p.color_category_id, p.campus_category_id, p.area_category_id, p.location_detail, p.event_date, p.expire_time from lf_post p where p.lifecycle_status = 'PUBLISHED' and p.review_status = 'APPROVED' and p.del_flag = '0' and p.post_id <> #{postId} and p.post_type <> #{postType} order by p.create_time desc, p.post_id desc

select match_id, lost_post_id, found_post_id, status, total_score, item_score, color_score, location_score, time_score, source, expire_time, create_time, update_time from lf_match where lost_post_id = #{lostPostId} and found_post_id = #{foundPostId} limit 1

select match_id, lost_post_id, found_post_id, status, total_score, item_score, color_score, location_score, time_score, source, expire_time, create_time, update_time from lf_match where match_id = #{matchId}
mapper.insert: insert into lf_match ( lost_post_id, found_post_id, status, total_score, item_score, color_score, location_score, time_score, source, expire_time, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{lostPostId}, #{foundPostId}, #{status}, #{totalScore}, #{itemScore}, #{colorScore}, #{locationScore}, #{timeScore}, #{source}, #{expireTime}, sysdate(), sysdate() )
mapper.update: update lf_match set status = #{status}, total_score = #{totalScore}, item_score = #{itemScore}, color_score = #{colorScore}, location_score = #{locationScore}, time_score = #{timeScore}, source = #{source}, expire_time = #{expireTime}, update_time = sysdate() where match_id = #{matchId}
mapper.select: select match_id, lost_post_id, found_post_id, status, total_score, item_score, color_score, location_score, time_score, source, expire_time, create_time, update_time from lf_match where (lost_post_id = #{postId} or found_post_id = #{postId}) and status in ('SUGGESTED', 'VIEWED', 'CONFIRMED') order by total_score desc, create_time desc
